Cedar Rapids, IA

Position:Part-time or PRN

Setting:In-House Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF)

Say Goodbye to Contract Company Burnout

Are you a passionate Physical Therapist who loves working with the geriatric population but is tired of unrealistic productivity metrics and endless corporate red tape?

AtNorthbrook Manor Care Center, we do things differently. We are proud to operate a 100% in-house therapy department. That means you work directly for our facility, collaborating closely with a dedicated interdisciplinary team that prioritizes patient outcomes over corporate quotas. Come build meaningful relationships with your patients and actually enjoy going to work

What You'll Be Doing:

As our full-time OT, you will be the driving force behind helping our residents regain their independence and confidently transition back to their daily lives.

  • Evaluate & Treat:Develop and implement highly individualized care plans focused on restoring function in Activities of Daily Living (ADLs) and Instrumental Activities of Daily Living (IADLs).
  • Innovate:Utilize evidence-based practices for cognitive rehabilitation, vision therapy, and adaptive equipment training to maximize patient autonomy and community integration.
  • Collaborate:Work hand-in-hand with our COTAs, PTs, SLPs, and nursing staff to ensure a seamless, patient-centered approach to rehab.
  • Educate:Empower patients, families, and facility staff with strategies to support long-term recovery and safe transitions.
  • Document:Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation in accordance with state, federal, and facility guidelines.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Education:Graduate of an accredited Occupational Therapy program.
  • Licensure:Active (or pending) state OT license in Iowa.
  • Certification:NBCOT certification is required.
  • Experience:Previous experience in a SNF or adult rehab setting is a plus, but a collaborative mindset and passion for patient care are what matter most.
  • Skills:Strong clinical reasoning, empathy, and excellent communication skills.

Why You'll Love Working With Us (The Perks):

Because we are in-house, we invest directly in YOU.

  • Competitive Salary:Commensurate with your experience.
  • Realistic Expectations:Ethical, manageable productivity standards.
  • Culture:A supportive, family-like environment where your voice actually matters.

Occupational Therapist Full-Time

Falls Village Rehabilitation and Wellnesshas an exciting opportunity for a Full-Time Occupational Therapist (OT)

We are looking for a dedicated OT to join our in-house rehabilitation team of outstanding professionals who provide person-centered care to our residents and patients. Our goal is to help each individual achieve meaningful outcomes while maintaining the highest standards of quality and compassion.

AtFalls Village Rehabilitation and Wellness, our clinical teams are committed to providing individualized care with compassion, collaboration, and excellence. Our staff works together to develop customized treatment programs and best practices designed to meet the unique needs of each resident and exceed industry standards.

Don't wait to make a difference-apply today

Occupational Therapist Responsibilities

  • Consult with residents and patients to understand their individual needs, concerns, functional limitations, and rehabilitation goals.
  • Perform comprehensive occupational therapy evaluations and assess and interpret evaluation findings and test results.
  • Develop individualized treatment plans based on evaluation findings, physician orders, patient needs, and established standards of care.
  • Create and implement personalized rehabilitation programs designed to improve functional independence, safety, mobility, and quality of life.
  • Provide skilled occupational therapy interventions to address activities of daily living (ADLs), functional mobility, strength, coordination, cognition, balance, and other areas of occupational performance.
  • Administer medically necessary occupational therapy treatments in accordance with the established plan of care.
  • Monitor resident and patient responses to treatment interventions and modify treatment approaches as clinically appropriate.
  • Establish and update individualized goals based on patient progress, functional needs, and clinical findings.
  • Provide education, training, and support to residents, patients, families, and caregivers regarding treatment plans, adaptive techniques, safety, and strategies to promote independence.
  • Collaborate with physicians, nursing staff, therapy team members, and other members of the interdisciplinary team (IDT) to coordinate and promote quality patient care.
  • Supervise and provide guidance to Occupational Therapy Assistants in accordance with applicable regulations and professional standards.
  • Communicate changes in resident or patient condition, progress, and treatment needs to the appropriate members of the healthcare team.
  • Ensure all documentation is completed accurately, thoroughly, and in a timely manner in accordance with company policies and applicable state and federal regulations.
  • Maintain accurate records related to evaluations, treatment sessions, progress, goals, and discharge planning.
  • Comply with all applicable rules, regulations, policies, procedures, and professional standards.
  • Attend required meetings and participate in other duties as designated by the Director of Rehabilitation.

Occupational Therapist Skills & Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a skilled nursing facility (SNF) or long-term care setting preferred.
  • Current knowledge of occupational therapy treatment practices, techniques, and interventions.
  • Familiarity with the Net Health electronic documentation system is preferred.
  • Strong clinical, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to effectively work with residents and patients with a variety of personalities, needs, and abilities.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with residents, families, caregivers, therapy team members, and other healthcare professionals.
  • Commitment to providing compassionate, patient-centered care.
  • Strong understanding of functional assessment, rehabilitation, and strategies to promote independence.

Occupational Therapist Requirements

  • Active and valid Occupational Therapy license inOH.
  • Must be in good standing with all applicable regulatory agencies and licensing boards.
  • Graduate of an accredited Occupational Therapy program.

Career Advantages

  • Full-Time Opportunity
  • In-house rehabilitation team
  • New graduates welcome to apply
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Flexible scheduling
  • Supportive, collaborative clinical environment
  • Opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of our residents and patients

All inquiries will be kept confidential.

Don't wait to make a difference-apply today

Occupational Therapist Responsibilities

  • Consult with residents and patients to understand their individual needs, concerns, functional limitations, and rehabilitation goals.
  • Perform comprehensive occupational therapy evaluations and assess and interpret evaluation findings and test results.
  • Develop individualized treatment plans based on evaluation findings, physician orders, patient needs, and established standards of care.
  • Create and implement personalized rehabilitation programs designed to improve functional independence, safety, mobility, and quality of life.
  • Provide skilled occupational therapy interventions to address activities of daily living (ADLs), functional mobility, strength, coordination, cognition, balance, and other areas of occupational performance.
  • Administer medically necessary occupational therapy treatments in accordance with the established plan of care.
  • Monitor resident and patient responses to treatment interventions and modify treatment approaches as clinically appropriate.
  • Establish and update individualized goals based on patient progress, functional needs, and clinical findings.
  • Provide education, training, and support to residents, patients, families, and caregivers regarding treatment plans, adaptive techniques, safety, and strategies to promote independence.
  • Collaborate with physicians, nursing staff, therapy team members, and other members of the interdisciplinary team (IDT) to coordinate and promote quality patient care.
  • Supervise and provide guidance to Occupational Therapy Assistants in accordance with applicable regulations and professional standards.
  • Communicate changes in resident or patient condition, progress, and treatment needs to the appropriate members of the healthcare team.
  • Ensure all documentation is completed accurately, thoroughly, and in a timely manner in accordance with company policies and applicable state and federal regulations.
  • Maintain accurate records related to evaluations, treatment sessions, progress, goals, and discharge planning.
  • Comply with all applicable rules, regulations, policies, procedures, and professional standards.
  • Attend required meetings and participate in other duties as designated by the Director of Rehabilitation.

Occupational Therapist Skills & Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a skilled nursing facility (SNF) or long-term care setting preferred.
  • Current knowledge of occupational therapy treatment practices, techniques, and interventions.
  • Familiarity with the Net Health electronic documentation system is preferred.
  • Strong clinical, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to effectively work with residents and patients with a variety of personalities, needs, and abilities.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with residents, families, caregivers, therapy team members, and other healthcare professionals.
  • Commitment to providing compassionate, patient-centered care.
  • Strong understanding of functional assessment, rehabilitation, and strategies to promote independence.

Occupational Therapist Requirements

  • Active and valid Occupational Therapy license inIL.
  • Must be in good standing with all applicable regulatory agencies and licensing boards.
  • Graduate of an accredited Occupational Therapy program.

Career Advantages

  • Full-time Opportunity
  • In-house rehabilitation team
  • New graduates welcome to apply
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Flexible scheduling
  • Supportive, collaborative clinical environment
  • Opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of our residents and patients

Occupational Therapist Responsibilities

  • Create and implement personalized rehabilitation programs designed to improve functional independence, safety, mobility, and quality of life.
  • Provide skilled occupational therapy interventions to address activities of daily living (ADLs), functional mobility, strength, coordination, cognition, balance, and other areas of occupational performance.

  • Monitor resident and patient responses to treatment interventions and modify treatment approaches as clinically appropriate.
  • Establish and update individualized goals based on patient progress, functional needs, and clinical findings.
  • Provide education, training, and support to residents, patients, families, and caregivers regarding treatment plans, adaptive techniques, safety, and strategies to promote independence.
  • Collaborate with physicians, nursing staff, therapy team members, and other members of the interdisciplinary team (IDT) to coordinate and promote quality patient care.
  • Supervise and provide guidance to Occupational Therapy Assistants in accordance with applicable regulations and professional standards.
  • Communicate changes in resident or patient condition, progress, and treatment needs to the appropriate members of the healthcare team.
  • Ensure all documentation is completed accurately, thoroughly, and in a timely manner in accordance with company policies and applicable state and federal regulations.
  • Maintain accurate records related to evaluations, treatment sessions, progress, goals, and discharge planning.
  • Comply with all applicable rules, regulations, policies, procedures, and professional standards.
  • Attend required meetings and participate in other duties as designated by the Director of Rehabilitation.

  • Previous experience in a skilled nursing facility (SNF) or long-term care setting preferred.

  • Strong clinical, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to effectively work with residents and patients with a variety of personalities, needs, and abilities.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with residents, families, caregivers, therapy team members, and other healthcare professionals.
  • Commitment to providing compassionate, patient-centered care.
  • Strong understanding of functional assessment, rehabilitation, and strategies to promote independence.

  • Active and valid Occupational Therapy license in NY.
  • Must be in good standing with all applicable regulatory agencies and licensing boards.
  • Graduate of an accredited Occupational Therapy program.

Cedar Rapids, IA

Position:Part-time or PRN

Setting:In-House Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF)

Say Goodbye to Contract Company Burnout

Are you a passionate Physical Therapist who loves working with the geriatric population but is tired of unrealistic productivity metrics and endless corporate red tape?

AtNorthbrook Manor Care Center, we do things differently. We are proud to operate a 100% in-house therapy department. That means you work directly for our facility, collaborating closely with a dedicated interdisciplinary team that prioritizes patient outcomes over corporate quotas. Come build meaningful relationships with your patients and actually enjoy going to work

As our full-time OT, you will be the driving force behind helping our residents regain their independence and confidently transition back to their daily lives.

  • Collaborate:Work hand-in-hand with our COTAs, PTs, SLPs, and nursing staff to ensure a seamless, patient-centered approach to rehab.
  • Educate:Empower patients, families, and facility staff with strategies to support long-term recovery and safe transitions.
  • Document:Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation in accordance with state, federal, and facility guidelines.

  • Education:Graduate of an accredited Occupational Therapy program.
  • Licensure:Active (or pending) state OT license in Iowa.
  • Certification:NBCOT certification is required.
  • Experience:Previous experience in a SNF or adult rehab setting is a plus, but a collaborative mindset and passion for patient care are what matter most.
  • Skills:Strong clinical reasoning, empathy, and excellent communication skills.

Why You'll Love Working With Us (The Perks):

Because we are in-house, we invest directly in YOU.

  • Competitive Salary:Commensurate with your experience.
  • Realistic Expectations:Ethical, manageable productivity standards.
  • Culture:A supportive, family-like environment where your voice actually matters.

  • Educate:Empower patients, families, and facility staff with strategies to support long-term recovery and safe transitions.

Part-time/PRN Occupational Therapist (OT) - In-House Rehab Team

Cedar Rapids, IA

Position:Part-time or PRN

Setting:In-House Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF)

Say Goodbye to Contract Company Burnout

Are you a passionate Physical Therapist who loves working with the geriatric population but is tired of unrealistic productivity metrics and endless corporate red tape?

AtNorthbrook Manor Care Center, we do things differently. We are proud to operate a 100% in-house therapy department. That means you work directly for our facility, collaborating closely with a dedicated interdisciplinary team that prioritizes patient outcomes over corporate quotas. Come build meaningful relationships with your patients and actually enjoy going to work

What You'll Be Doing:

As our full-time OT, you will be the driving force behind helping our residents regain their independence and confidently transition back to their daily lives.

  • Evaluate & Treat:Develop and implement highly individualized care plans focused on restoring function in Activities of Daily Living (ADLs) and Instrumental Activities of Daily Living (IADLs).
  • Innovate:Utilize evidence-based practices for cognitive rehabilitation, vision therapy, and adaptive equipment training to maximize patient autonomy and community integration.
  • Collaborate:Work hand-in-hand with our COTAs, PTs, SLPs, and nursing staff to ensure a seamless, patient-centered approach to rehab.
  • Educate:Empower patients, families, and facility staff with strategies to support long-term recovery and safe transitions.
  • Document:Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation in accordance with state, federal, and facility guidelines.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Education:Graduate of an accredited Occupational Therapy program.
  • Licensure:Active (or pending) state OT license in Iowa.
  • Certification:NBCOT certification is required.
  • Experience:Previous experience in a SNF or adult rehab setting is a plus, but a collaborative mindset and passion for patient care are what matter most.
  • Skills:Strong clinical reasoning, empathy, and excellent communication skills.

Why You'll Love Working With Us (The Perks):

Because we are in-house, we invest directly in YOU.

  • Competitive Salary:Commensurate with your experience.
  • Realistic Expectations:Ethical, manageable productivity standards.
  • Culture:A supportive, family-like environment where your voice actually matters.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you are ready to practice therapy the way it was meant to be practiced, we want to meet you

Occupational Therapist Responsibilities

  • Consult with residents and patients to understand their individual needs, concerns, functional limitations, and rehabilitation goals.
  • Perform comprehensive occupational therapy evaluations and assess and interpret evaluation findings and test results.
  • Develop individualized treatment plans based on evaluation findings, physician orders, patient needs, and established standards of care.
  • Create and implement personalized rehabilitation programs designed to improve functional independence, safety, mobility, and quality of life.
  • Provide skilled occupational therapy interventions to address activities of daily living (ADLs), functional mobility, strength, coordination, cognition, balance, and other areas of occupational performance.
  • Administer medically necessary occupational therapy treatments in accordance with the established plan of care.
  • Monitor resident and patient responses to treatment interventions and modify treatment approaches as clinically appropriate.
  • Establish and update individualized goals based on patient progress, functional needs, and clinical findings.
  • Provide education, training, and support to residents, patients, families, and caregivers regarding treatment plans, adaptive techniques, safety, and strategies to promote independence.
  • Collaborate with physicians, nursing staff, therapy team members, and other members of the interdisciplinary team (IDT) to coordinate and promote quality patient care.
  • Supervise and provide guidance to Occupational Therapy Assistants in accordance with applicable regulations and professional standards.
  • Communicate changes in resident or patient condition, progress, and treatment needs to the appropriate members of the healthcare team.
  • Ensure all documentation is completed accurately, thoroughly, and in a timely manner in accordance with company policies and applicable state and federal regulations.
  • Maintain accurate records related to evaluations, treatment sessions, progress, goals, and discharge planning.
  • Comply with all applicable rules, regulations, policies, procedures, and professional standards.
  • Attend required meetings and participate in other duties as designated by the Director of Rehabilitation.

Occupational Therapist Skills & Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a skilled nursing facility (SNF) or long-term care setting preferred.
  • Current knowledge of occupational therapy treatment practices, techniques, and interventions.

  • Strong clinical, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to effectively work with residents and patients with a variety of personalities, needs, and abilities.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with residents, families, caregivers, therapy team members, and other healthcare professionals.

  • Active and valid Occupational Therapy license inOH.
  • Must be in good standing with all applicable regulatory agencies and licensing boards.
  • Graduate of an accredited Occupational Therapy program.

Position:Part-time or PRN

Setting:In-House Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF)

Say Goodbye to Contract Company Burnout

Are you a passionate Physical Therapist who loves working with the geriatric population but is tired of unrealistic productivity metrics and endless corporate red tape?

AtNorthbrook Manor Care Center, we do things differently. We are proud to operate a 100% in-house therapy department. That means you work directly for our facility, collaborating closely with a dedicated interdisciplinary team that prioritizes patient outcomes over corporate quotas. Come build meaningful relationships with your patients and actually enjoy going to work

What You'll Be Doing:

As our full-time OT, you will be the driving force behind helping our residents regain their independence and confidently transition back to their daily lives.

  • Evaluate & Treat:Develop and implement highly individualized care plans focused on restoring function in Activities of Daily Living (ADLs) and Instrumental Activities of Daily Living (IADLs).
  • Innovate:Utilize evidence-based practices for cognitive rehabilitation, vision therapy, and adaptive equipment training to maximize patient autonomy and community integration.
  • Collaborate:Work hand-in-hand with our COTAs, PTs, SLPs, and nursing staff to ensure a seamless, patient-centered approach to rehab.
  • Educate:Empower patients, families, and facility staff with strategies to support long-term recovery and safe transitions.
  • Document:Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation in accordance with state, federal, and facility guidelines.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Education:Graduate of an accredited Occupational Therapy program.
  • Licensure:Active (or pending) state OT license in Iowa.
  • Certification:NBCOT certification is required.
  • Experience:Previous experience in a SNF or adult rehab setting is a plus, but a collaborative mindset and passion for patient care are what matter most.
  • Skills:Strong clinical reasoning, empathy, and excellent communication skills.

Why You'll Love Working With Us (The Perks):

Because we are in-house, we invest directly in YOU.

  • Competitive Salary:Commensurate with your experience.
  • Realistic Expectations:Ethical, manageable productivity standards.
  • Culture:A supportive, family-like environment where your voice actually matters.

If you are ready to practice therapy the way it was meant to be practiced, we want to meet you

Occupational Therapist Responsibilities

  • Consult with residents and patients to understand their individual needs, concerns, functional limitations, and rehabilitation goals.
  • Perform comprehensive occupational therapy evaluations and assess and interpret evaluation findings and test results.
  • Develop individualized treatment plans based on evaluation findings, physician orders, patient needs, and established standards of care.
  • Create and implement personalized rehabilitation programs designed to improve functional independence, safety, mobility, and quality of life.
  • Provide skilled occupational therapy interventions to address activities of daily living (ADLs), functional mobility, strength, coordination, cognition, balance, and other areas of occupational performance.
  • Administer medically necessary occupational therapy treatments in accordance with the established plan of care.
  • Monitor resident and patient responses to treatment interventions and modify treatment approaches as clinically appropriate.
  • Establish and update individualized goals based on patient progress, functional needs, and clinical findings.
  • Provide education, training, and support to residents, patients, families, and caregivers regarding treatment plans, adaptive techniques, safety, and strategies to promote independence.
  • Collaborate with physicians, nursing staff, therapy team members, and other members of the interdisciplinary team (IDT) to coordinate and promote quality patient care.
  • Supervise and provide guidance to Occupational Therapy Assistants in accordance with applicable regulations and professional standards.
  • Communicate changes in resident or patient condition, progress, and treatment needs to the appropriate members of the healthcare team.
  • Ensure all documentation is completed accurately, thoroughly, and in a timely manner in accordance with company policies and applicable state and federal regulations.
  • Maintain accurate records related to evaluations, treatment sessions, progress, goals, and discharge planning.
  • Comply with all applicable rules, regulations, policies, procedures, and professional standards.
  • Attend required meetings and participate in other duties as designated by the Director of Rehabilitation.

Occupational Therapist Skills & Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a skilled nursing facility (SNF) or long-term care setting preferred.
  • Current knowledge of occupational therapy treatment practices, techniques, and interventions.
  • Familiarity with the Net Health electronic documentation system is preferred.
  • Strong clinical, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to effectively work with residents and patients with a variety of personalities, needs, and abilities.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with residents, families, caregivers, therapy team members, and other healthcare professionals.
  • Commitment to providing compassionate, patient-centered care.
  • Strong understanding of functional assessment, rehabilitation, and strategies to promote independence.

  • Active and valid Occupational Therapy license in MA.
  • Must be in good standing with all applicable regulatory agencies and licensing boards.
  • Graduate of an accredited Occupational Therapy program.

Full-Time Physical Therapist (PT) - In-House Rehab Team!

Position: Full-Time (FT)

Setting: In-House Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF)

Say Goodbye to Contract Company Burnout!

Are you a passionate Physical Therapist who loves working with the geriatric population but is tired of unrealistic productivity metrics and endless corporate red tape?

At Royal Wood Mill, we do things differently. We are proud to operate a 100% in-house therapy department. That means you work directly for our facility, collaborating closely with a dedicated interdisciplinary team that prioritizes patient outcomes over corporate quotas. Come build meaningful relationships with your patients and actually enjoy going to work!

What You’ll Be Doing:

As our full-time PT, you will lead the charge in restoring mobility, strength, and confidence for our residents.

  • Evaluate & Treat: Provide comprehensive functional assessments and design targeted, evidence-based treatment plans to address mobility, balance, gait, and pain management.
  • Innovate: Implement specialized programs (like fall prevention and joint replacement recovery) to ensure our patients achieve their highest possible level of independence and success.
  • Collaborate: Lead and partner seamlessly with our highly skilled Physical Therapist Assistants (PTAs), alongside OTs, SLPs, and nursing teams, to deliver cohesive clinical care.
  • Educate: Empower patients and their families with the physical tools and knowledge needed for safe discharges and active community integration.
  • Document: Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation in accordance with state, federal, and facility guidelines.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Education: Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapy program (DPT preferred).
  • Licensure: Active (or pending) state PT license required.
  • Experience: Previous experience in a SNF or adult rehab setting is a plus, but a collaborative mindset and passion for patient care are what matter most.
  • Skills: Strong clinical reasoning, leadership capabilities, empathy, and excellent communication skills.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us (The Perks!):

Because we are in-house, we invest directly in YOU.

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with your experience.
  • Realistic Expectations: Ethical, manageable productivity standards.
  • Comprehensive Health Benefits: Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance.
  • Generous PTO: Paid time off and paid holidays to support your work-life balance.
  • Retirement: 401(k) plan.
  • Culture: A supportive, family-like environment where your voice actually matters.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you are ready to practice therapy the way it was meant to be practiced, we want to meet you!

Position: Full-Time (FT)

Setting: In-House Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF)

Say Goodbye to Contract Company Burnout!

Are you a passionate Physical Therapist who loves working with the geriatric population but is tired of unrealistic productivity metrics and endless corporate red tape?

At Royal Braintree Nursing and Rehabilitation Center, we do things differently. We are proud to operate a 100% in-house therapy department. That means you work directly for our facility, collaborating closely with a dedicated interdisciplinary team that prioritizes patient outcomes over corporate quotas. Come build meaningful relationships with your patients and actually enjoy going to work!

What You’ll Be Doing:

As our full-time PT, you will lead the charge in restoring mobility, strength, and confidence for our residents.

  • Evaluate & Treat: Provide comprehensive functional assessments and design targeted, evidence-based treatment plans to address mobility, balance, gait, and pain management.
  • Innovate: Implement specialized programs (like fall prevention and joint replacement recovery) to ensure our patients achieve their highest possible level of independence and success.
  • Collaborate: Lead and partner seamlessly with our highly skilled Physical Therapist Assistants (PTAs), alongside OTs, SLPs, and nursing teams, to deliver cohesive clinical care.
  • Educate: Empower patients and their families with the physical tools and knowledge needed for safe discharges and active community integration.
  • Document: Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation in accordance with state, federal, and facility guidelines.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Education: Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapy program (DPT preferred).
  • Licensure: Active (or pending) state PT license required.
  • Experience: Previous experience in a SNF or adult rehab setting is a plus, but a collaborative mindset and passion for patient care are what matter most.
  • Skills: Strong clinical reasoning, leadership capabilities, empathy, and excellent communication skills.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us (The Perks!):

Because we are in-house, we invest directly in YOU.

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with your experience.
  • Realistic Expectations: Ethical, manageable productivity standards.
  • Comprehensive Health Benefits: Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance.
  • Generous PTO: Paid time off and paid holidays to support your work-life balance.
  • Retirement: 401(k) plan.
  • Culture: A supportive, family-like environment where your voice actually matters.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you are ready to practice therapy the way it was meant to be practiced, we want to meet you!

$5,000 Sign-On Bonus for New Full-Time Hires!

Full-Time & Per Diem (PRN) - In-House Subacute Rehabilitation

Nexus at Forest Edge

Job Type: Full-Time & Per Diem (PRN)

Setting: In-House Subacute Rehabilitation & Skilled Nursing

Job Summary

Nexus at Forest Edge is seeking compassionate and motivated Physical Therapists (PTs) to join our in-house rehabilitation team. We are hiring for both Full-Time and Per Diem (PRN) positions in our subacute rehabilitation and skilled nursing setting.

New Full-Time PTs are eligible for a $5,000 Sign-On Bonus! Join a collaborative rehabilitation team dedicated to helping residents maximize their independence, mobility, and quality of life.

The ideal candidate will evaluate and treat residents with physical impairments, functional limitations, and mobility-related conditions while working closely with an interdisciplinary team focused on exceptional patient outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Evaluate residents and develop individualized treatment plans based on functional needs and physician orders
  • Provide skilled physical therapy services in accordance with physician orders and facility policies
  • Implement therapeutic exercise programs, gait training, transfer training, balance activities, and functional mobility interventions
  • Perform ongoing reassessments and modify treatment plans based on patient progress
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation in compliance with state, federal, and facility guidelines
  • Collaborate with physicians, nursing staff, occupational therapists, speech therapists, and families regarding patient progress and discharge planning
  • Educate patients, caregivers, and staff on mobility techniques, safety awareness, and fall prevention strategies
  • Participate in interdisciplinary care plan meetings
  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory, ethical, and professional standards

Qualifications

  • Doctorate or Master's Degree in Physical Therapy from an accredited program
  • Current Illinois Physical Therapist license required
  • Experience in skilled nursing, subacute rehabilitation, or geriatric settings preferred
  • Strong clinical reasoning, communication, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team

Benefits

Full-Time

  • $5,000 Sign-On Bonus for new Full-Time PT hires
  • Competitive compensation
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Continuing education opportunities
  • Supportive in-house rehabilitation team
  • Career growth and advancement opportunities

Per Diem (PRN)

  • Flexible scheduling based on facility needs
  • Competitive hourly compensation
  • Opportunity to work in a supportive in-house rehabilitation environment
  • Collaboration with an experienced interdisciplinary care team

Why Join Us?

At Nexus at Forest Edge, you'll become part of a dedicated in-house rehabilitation team committed to delivering high-quality, patient-centered care. Whether you're seeking a Full-Time career opportunity or the flexibility of a PRN position, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on residents' recovery, mobility, and independence.

Apply today and take advantage of our $5,000 Sign-On Bonus for new Full-Time Physical Therapists!

Full-Time Physical Therapist (PT) - In-House Rehab Team!

Position: Full-Time (FT)

Setting: In-House Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF)

Say Goodbye to Contract Company Burnout!

Are you a passionate Physical Therapist who loves working with the geriatric population but is tired of unrealistic productivity metrics and endless corporate red tape?

we do things differently. We are proud to operate a 100% in-house therapy department. That means you work directly for our facility, collaborating closely with a dedicated interdisciplinary team that prioritizes patient outcomes over corporate quotas. Come build meaningful relationships with your patients and actually enjoy going to work!

What You'll Be Doing:

As our full-time PT, you will lead the charge in restoring mobility, strength, and confidence for our residents.

  • Evaluate & Treat: Provide comprehensive functional assessments and design targeted, evidence-based treatment plans to address mobility, balance, gait, and pain management.
  • Innovate: Implement specialized programs (like fall prevention and joint replacement recovery) to ensure our patients achieve their highest possible level of independence and success.
  • Collaborate: Lead and partner seamlessly with our highly skilled Physical Therapist Assistants (PTAs), alongside OTs, SLPs, and nursing teams, to deliver cohesive clinical care.
  • Educate: Empower patients and their families with the physical tools and knowledge needed for safe discharges and active community integration.
  • Document: Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation in accordance with state, federal, and facility guidelines.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Education: Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapy program (DPT preferred).
  • Licensure: Active (or pending) state PT license in CT.
  • Experience: Previous experience in a SNF or adult rehab setting is a plus, but a collaborative mindset and passion for patient care are what matter most.
  • Skills: Strong clinical reasoning, leadership capabilities, empathy, and excellent communication skills.

Why You'll Love Working With Us (The Perks!):

Because we are in-house, we invest directly in YOU.

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with your experience.
  • Realistic Expectations: Ethical, manageable productivity standards.
  • Comprehensive Health Benefits: Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance.
  • Generous PTO: Paid time off and paid holidays to support your work-life balance.
  • Culture: A supportive, family-like environment where your voice actually matters.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you are ready to practice therapy the way it was meant to be practiced, we want to meet you!

Physical Therapist

Nexus at Westmonthas an exciting opportunity for a Physical Therapist (PT)

We are looking for a dedicated PT to join our in-house rehabilitation team of outstanding professionals who provide person-centered care to our residents and patients. Our goal is to help each individual achieve meaningful outcomes while maintaining the highest standards of quality and compassion.

AtNexus at Westmont, our clinical teams are committed to providing individualized care with compassion, collaboration, and excellence. Our staff works together to develop customized treatment programs and best practices designed to meet the unique needs of each resident and exceed industry standards.

Don't wait to make a difference-apply today

Physical Therapist Responsibilities

  • Consult patients to understand their individual needs, concerns, and rehabilitation goals.
  • Perform comprehensive patient evaluations and assess and interpret evaluation findings and test results.
  • Develop individualized treatment plans using a variety of evidence-based physical therapy techniques and interventions.
  • Create personalized rehabilitation programs designed to help patients achieve their functional goals and maximize independence.
  • Administer medically prescribed physical therapy treatments to relieve pain, improve or restore function, increase mobility, and promote healing.
  • Ensure all treatment is provided in accordance with the established plan of care.
  • Monitor patient responses to treatment interventions and modify treatment approaches as clinically appropriate in collaboration with the interdisciplinary team (IDT).
  • Provide clinical support, education, and guidance to patients, family members, and caregivers.
  • Collaborate with other members of the interdisciplinary team to promote coordinated, high-quality patient care.
  • Ensure all documentation is completed accurately, thoroughly, and in a timely manner in accordance with company policies and applicable state and federal regulations.
  • Comply with all applicable rules, regulations, policies, procedures, and professional standards.
  • Attend required meetings and participate in other duties as designated by the Director of Rehabilitation.

Physical Therapist Skills & Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a skilled nursing facility (SNF) or long-term care setting preferred.
  • Current knowledge of physical therapy treatment practices, techniques, and interventions.
  • Familiarity with the Net Health electronic documentation system is preferred.
  • Strong clinical, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to effectively work with patients and residents with a variety of personalities, needs, and abilities.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with patients, families, caregivers, and members of the interdisciplinary team.
  • Commitment to providing compassionate, patient-centered care.

Physical Therapist Requirements

  • Active and valid Physical Therapy license inIL.
  • Must be in good standing with all applicable regulatory agencies and licensing boards.

Career Advantages

  • Opportunity
  • In-house rehabilitation team
  • New graduates are welcome to apply
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Flexible scheduling
  • Supportive, collaborative clinical environment
  • Opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of our residents and patients

All inquiries will be kept confidential.

Physical Therapist Responsibilities

  • Monitor patient responses to treatment interventions and modify treatment approaches as clinically appropriate in collaboration with the interdisciplinary team (IDT).

  • Comply with all applicable rules, regulations, policies, procedures, and professional standards.
  • Attend required meetings and participate in other duties as designated by the Director of Rehabilitation.

Physical Therapist Skills & Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a skilled nursing facility (SNF) or long-term care setting preferred.
  • Current knowledge of physical therapy treatment practices, techniques, and interventions.
  • Familiarity with the Net Health electronic documentation system is preferred.
  • Strong clinical, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to effectively work with patients and residents with a variety of personalities, needs, and abilities.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with patients, families, caregivers, and members of the interdisciplinary team.

Don't wait to make a difference-apply today

Physical Therapist Responsibilities

  • Consult patients to understand their individual needs, concerns, and rehabilitation goals.

  • Create personalized rehabilitation programs designed to help patients achieve their functional goals and maximize independence.
  • Administer medically prescribed physical therapy treatments to relieve pain, improve or restore function, increase mobility, and promote healing.
  • Ensure all treatment is provided in accordance with the established plan of care.
  • Monitor patient responses to treatment interventions and modify treatment approaches as clinically appropriate in collaboration with the interdisciplinary team (IDT).
  • Provide clinical support, education, and guidance to patients, family members, and caregivers.
  • Collaborate with other members of the interdisciplinary team to promote coordinated, high-quality patient care.
  • Ensure all documentation is completed accurately, thoroughly, and in a timely manner in accordance with company policies and applicable state and federal regulations.
  • Comply with all applicable rules, regulations, policies, procedures, and professional standards.
  • Attend required meetings and participate in other duties as designated by the Director of Rehabilitation.

Physical Therapist Skills & Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a skilled nursing facility (SNF) or long-term care setting preferred.
  • Current knowledge of physical therapy treatment practices, techniques, and interventions.
  • Familiarity with the Net Health electronic documentation system is preferred.
  • Strong clinical, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to effectively work with patients and residents with a variety of personalities, needs, and abilities.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with patients, families, caregivers, and members of the interdisciplinary team.
  • Commitment to providing compassionate, patient-centered care.

Physical Therapist Requirements

  • Active and valid Physical Therapy license inIL.
  • Must be in good standing with all applicable regulatory agencies and licensing boards.

Nexus at Westmont has an exciting opportunity for a Physical Therapist (PT)

We are looking for a dedicated PT to join our in-house rehabilitation team of outstanding professionals who provide person-centered care to our residents and patients. Our goal is to help each individual achieve meaningful outcomes while maintaining the highest standards of quality and compassion.

At Nexus at Westmont, our clinical teams are committed to providing individualized care with compassion, collaboration, and excellence. Our staff works together to develop customized treatment programs and best practices designed to meet the unique needs of each resident and exceed industry standards.

Don't wait to make a difference-apply today

Physical Therapist Responsibilities

  • Consult patients to understand their individual needs, concerns, and rehabilitation goals.
  • Perform comprehensive patient evaluations and assess and interpret evaluation findings and test results.
  • Develop individualized treatment plans using a variety of evidence-based physical therapy techniques and interventions.
  • Create personalized rehabilitation programs designed to help patients achieve their functional goals and maximize independence.
  • Administer medically prescribed physical therapy treatments to relieve pain, improve or restore function, increase mobility, and promote healing.
  • Ensure all treatment is provided in accordance with the established plan of care.
  • Monitor patient responses to treatment interventions and modify treatment approaches as clinically appropriate in collaboration with the interdisciplinary team (IDT).
  • Provide clinical support, education, and guidance to patients, family members, and caregivers.
  • Collaborate with other members of the interdisciplinary team to promote coordinated, high-quality patient care.
  • Ensure all documentation is completed accurately, thoroughly, and in a timely manner in accordance with company policies and applicable state and federal regulations.
  • Comply with all applicable rules, regulations, policies, procedures, and professional standards.
  • Attend required meetings and participate in other duties as designated by the Director of Rehabilitation.

Physical Therapist Skills & Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a skilled nursing facility (SNF) or long-term care setting preferred.
  • Current knowledge of physical therapy treatment practices, techniques, and interventions.
  • Familiarity with the Net Health electronic documentation system is preferred.
  • Strong clinical, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to effectively work with patients and residents with a variety of personalities, needs, and abilities.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with patients, families, caregivers, and members of the interdisciplinary team.
  • Commitment to providing compassionate, patient-centered care.

Physical Therapist Requirements

  • Active and valid Physical Therapy license inIL.
  • Must be in good standing with all applicable regulatory agencies and licensing boards.

Part-time/PRN Physical Therapist (PT) - In-House Rehab Team

Cedar Rapids, IA

Position:Part-time or PRN

Setting:In-House Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF)

Say Goodbye to Contract Company Burnout

Are you a passionate Physical Therapist who loves working with the geriatric population but is tired of unrealistic productivity metrics and endless corporate red tape?

AtNorthbrook Manor Care Center, we do things differently. We are proud to operate a 100% in-house therapy department. That means you work directly for our facility, collaborating closely with a dedicated interdisciplinary team that prioritizes patient outcomes over corporate quotas. Come build meaningful relationships with your patients and actually enjoy going to work

What You'll Be Doing:

As our full-time PT, you will lead the charge in restoring mobility, strength, and confidence for our residents.

  • Evaluate & Treat:Provide comprehensive functional assessments and design targeted, evidence-based treatment plans to address mobility, balance, gait, and pain management.
  • Innovate:Implement specialized programs (like fall prevention and joint replacement recovery) to ensure our patients achieve their highest possible level of independence and success.
  • Collaborate:Lead and partner seamlessly with our highly skilled Physical Therapist Assistants (PTAs), alongside OTs, SLPs, and nursing teams, to deliver cohesive clinical care.
  • Educate:Empower patients and their families with the physical tools and knowledge needed for safe discharges and active community integration.
  • Document:Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation in accordance with state, federal, and facility guidelines.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Education:Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapy program (DPT preferred).
  • Licensure:Active (or pending) state PT license in Iowa.
  • Experience:Previous experience in a SNF or adult rehab setting is a plus, but a collaborative mindset and passion for patient care are what matter most.
  • Skills:Strong clinical reasoning, leadership capabilities, empathy, and excellent communication skills.

Why You'll Love Working With Us (The Perks):

Because we are in-house, we invest directly in YOU.

  • Competitive Salary:Commensurate with your experience.
  • Realistic Expectations:Ethical, manageable productivity standards.
  • Culture:A supportive, family-like environment where your voice actually matters.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you are ready to practice therapy the way it was meant to be practiced, we want to meet you

Cedar Rapids, IA

Position:Part-time or PRN

Setting:In-House Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF)

Say Goodbye to Contract Company Burnout

Are you a passionate Physical Therapist who loves working with the geriatric population but is tired of unrealistic productivity metrics and endless corporate red tape?

AtNorthbrook Manor Care Center, we do things differently. We are proud to operate a 100% in-house therapy department. That means you work directly for our facility, collaborating closely with a dedicated interdisciplinary team that prioritizes patient outcomes over corporate quotas. Come build meaningful relationships with your patients and actually enjoy going to work

What You'll Be Doing:

As our full-time PT, you will lead the charge in restoring mobility, strength, and confidence for our residents.

  • Evaluate & Treat:Provide comprehensive functional assessments and design targeted, evidence-based treatment plans to address mobility, balance, gait, and pain management.
  • Innovate:Implement specialized programs (like fall prevention and joint replacement recovery) to ensure our patients achieve their highest possible level of independence and success.
  • Collaborate:Lead and partner seamlessly with our highly skilled Physical Therapist Assistants (PTAs), alongside OTs, SLPs, and nursing teams, to deliver cohesive clinical care.
  • Educate:Empower patients and their families with the physical tools and knowledge needed for safe discharges and active community integration.
  • Document:Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation in accordance with state, federal, and facility guidelines.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Education:Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapy program (DPT preferred).
  • Licensure:Active (or pending) state PT license in Iowa.
  • Experience:Previous experience in a SNF or adult rehab setting is a plus, but a collaborative mindset and passion for patient care are what matter most.
  • Skills:Strong clinical reasoning, leadership capabilities, empathy, and excellent communication skills.

Why You'll Love Working With Us (The Perks):

Because we are in-house, we invest directly in YOU.

  • Competitive Salary:Commensurate with your experience.
  • Realistic Expectations:Ethical, manageable productivity standards.
  • Culture:A supportive, family-like environment where your voice actually matters.

If you are ready to practice therapy the way it was meant to be practiced, we want to meet you

Part-time/PRN Physical Therapist (PT) - In-House Rehab Team

Cedar Rapids, IA

Position:Part-time or PRN

Setting:In-House Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF)

Say Goodbye to Contract Company Burnout

Are you a passionate Physical Therapist who loves working with the geriatric population but is tired of unrealistic productivity metrics and endless corporate red tape?

AtNorthbrook Manor Care Center, we do things differently. We are proud to operate a 100% in-house therapy department. That means you work directly for our facility, collaborating closely with a dedicated interdisciplinary team that prioritizes patient outcomes over corporate quotas. Come build meaningful relationships with your patients and actually enjoy going to work

What You'll Be Doing:

As our full-time PT, you will lead the charge in restoring mobility, strength, and confidence for our residents.

  • Evaluate & Treat:Provide comprehensive functional assessments and design targeted, evidence-based treatment plans to address mobility, balance, gait, and pain management.
  • Innovate:Implement specialized programs (like fall prevention and joint replacement recovery) to ensure our patients achieve their highest possible level of independence and success.
  • Collaborate:Lead and partner seamlessly with our highly skilled Physical Therapist Assistants (PTAs), alongside OTs, SLPs, and nursing teams, to deliver cohesive clinical care.
  • Educate:Empower patients and their families with the physical tools and knowledge needed for safe discharges and active community integration.
  • Document:Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation in accordance with state, federal, and facility guidelines.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Education:Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapy program (DPT preferred).
  • Licensure:Active (or pending) state PT license in Iowa.
  • Experience:Previous experience in a SNF or adult rehab setting is a plus, but a collaborative mindset and passion for patient care are what matter most.
  • Skills:Strong clinical reasoning, leadership capabilities, empathy, and excellent communication skills.

Why You'll Love Working With Us (The Perks):

Because we are in-house, we invest directly in YOU.

  • Competitive Salary:Commensurate with your experience.
  • Realistic Expectations:Ethical, manageable productivity standards.
  • Culture:A supportive, family-like environment where your voice actually matters.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you are ready to practice therapy the way it was meant to be practiced, we want to meet you

Part-time/PRN Physical Therapist (PT) - In-House Rehab Team

Cedar Rapids, IA

Position:Part-time or PRN

Setting:In-House Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF)

Say Goodbye to Contract Company Burnout

Are you a passionate Physical Therapist who loves working with the geriatric population but is tired of unrealistic productivity metrics and endless corporate red tape?

AtNorthbrook Manor Care Center, we do things differently. We are proud to operate a 100% in-house therapy department. That means you work directly for our facility, collaborating closely with a dedicated interdisciplinary team that prioritizes patient outcomes over corporate quotas. Come build meaningful relationships with your patients and actually enjoy going to work

What You'll Be Doing:

As our full-time PT, you will lead the charge in restoring mobility, strength, and confidence for our residents.

  • Evaluate & Treat:Provide comprehensive functional assessments and design targeted, evidence-based treatment plans to address mobility, balance, gait, and pain management.
  • Innovate:Implement specialized programs (like fall prevention and joint replacement recovery) to ensure our patients achieve their highest possible level of independence and success.
  • Collaborate:Lead and partner seamlessly with our highly skilled Physical Therapist Assistants (PTAs), alongside OTs, SLPs, and nursing teams, to deliver cohesive clinical care.
  • Educate:Empower patients and their families with the physical tools and knowledge needed for safe discharges and active community integration.
  • Document:Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation in accordance with state, federal, and facility guidelines.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Education:Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapy program (DPT preferred).
  • Licensure:Active (or pending) state PT license in Iowa.
  • Experience:Previous experience in a SNF or adult rehab setting is a plus, but a collaborative mindset and passion for patient care are what matter most.
  • Skills:Strong clinical reasoning, leadership capabilities, empathy, and excellent communication skills.

Why You'll Love Working With Us (The Perks):

Because we are in-house, we invest directly in YOU.

  • Competitive Salary:Commensurate with your experience.
  • Realistic Expectations:Ethical, manageable productivity standards.
  • Culture:A supportive, family-like environment where your voice actually matters.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you are ready to practice therapy the way it was meant to be practiced, we want to meet you

Physical Therapist Responsibilities

  • Attend required meetings and participate in other duties as designated by the Director of Rehabilitation.

Physical Therapist Skills & Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a skilled nursing facility (SNF) or long-term care setting preferred.
  • Current knowledge of physical therapy treatment practices, techniques, and interventions.
  • Familiarity with the Net Health electronic documentation system is preferred.
  • Strong clinical, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to effectively work with patients and residents with a variety of personalities, needs, and abilities.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with patients, families, caregivers, and members of the interdisciplinary team.
  • Commitment to providing compassionate, patient-centered care.

Cedar Rapids, IA

Position:Part-time or PRN

Setting:In-House Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF)

Say Goodbye to Contract Company Burnout

Are you a passionate Physical Therapist who loves working with the geriatric population but is tired of unrealistic productivity metrics and endless corporate red tape?

AtNorthbrook Manor Care Center, we do things differently. We are proud to operate a 100% in-house therapy department. That means you work directly for our facility, collaborating closely with a dedicated interdisciplinary team that prioritizes patient outcomes over corporate quotas. Come build meaningful relationships with your patients and actually enjoy going to work

What You'll Be Doing:

As our full-time PT, you will lead the charge in restoring mobility, strength, and confidence for our residents.

  • Evaluate & Treat:Provide comprehensive functional assessments and design targeted, evidence-based treatment plans to address mobility, balance, gait, and pain management.
  • Innovate:Implement specialized programs (like fall prevention and joint replacement recovery) to ensure our patients achieve their highest possible level of independence and success.
  • Collaborate:Lead and partner seamlessly with our highly skilled Physical Therapist Assistants (PTAs), alongside OTs, SLPs, and nursing teams, to deliver cohesive clinical care.
  • Educate:Empower patients and their families with the physical tools and knowledge needed for safe discharges and active community integration.
  • Document:Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation in accordance with state, federal, and facility guidelines.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Education:Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapy program (DPT preferred).
  • Licensure:Active (or pending) state PT license in Iowa.
  • Experience:Previous experience in a SNF or adult rehab setting is a plus, but a collaborative mindset and passion for patient care are what matter most.
  • Skills:Strong clinical reasoning, leadership capabilities, empathy, and excellent communication skills.

Why You'll Love Working With Us (The Perks):

Because we are in-house, we invest directly in YOU.

  • Competitive Salary:Commensurate with your experience.
  • Realistic Expectations:Ethical, manageable productivity standards.
  • Culture:A supportive, family-like environment where your voice actually matters.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you are ready to practice therapy the way it was meant to be practiced, we want to meet you

Part-time/PRN Physical Therapist (PT) - In-House Rehab Team

Cedar Rapids, IA

Position:Part-time or PRN

Setting:In-House Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF)

Say Goodbye to Contract Company Burnout

Are you a passionate Physical Therapist who loves working with the geriatric population but is tired of unrealistic productivity metrics and endless corporate red tape?

AtNorthbrook Manor Care Center, we do things differently. We are proud to operate a 100% in-house therapy department. That means you work directly for our facility, collaborating closely with a dedicated interdisciplinary team that prioritizes patient outcomes over corporate quotas. Come build meaningful relationships with your patients and actually enjoy going to work

What You'll Be Doing:

As our full-time PT, you will lead the charge in restoring mobility, strength, and confidence for our residents.

  • Evaluate & Treat:Provide comprehensive functional assessments and design targeted, evidence-based treatment plans to address mobility, balance, gait, and pain management.
  • Innovate:Implement specialized programs (like fall prevention and joint replacement recovery) to ensure our patients achieve their highest possible level of independence and success.
  • Collaborate:Lead and partner seamlessly with our highly skilled Physical Therapist Assistants (PTAs), alongside OTs, SLPs, and nursing teams, to deliver cohesive clinical care.
  • Educate:Empower patients and their families with the physical tools and knowledge needed for safe discharges and active community integration.
  • Document:Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation in accordance with state, federal, and facility guidelines.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Education:Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapy program (DPT preferred).
  • Licensure:Active (or pending) state PT license in Iowa.
  • Experience:Previous experience in a SNF or adult rehab setting is a plus, but a collaborative mindset and passion for patient care are what matter most.
  • Skills:Strong clinical reasoning, leadership capabilities, empathy, and excellent communication skills.

Why You'll Love Working With Us (The Perks):

Because we are in-house, we invest directly in YOU.

  • Competitive Salary:Commensurate with your experience.
  • Realistic Expectations:Ethical, manageable productivity standards.
  • Culture:A supportive, family-like environment where your voice actually matters.

Physical Therapist Responsibilities

  • Consult patients to understand their individual needs, concerns, and rehabilitation goals.

  • Develop individualized treatment plans using a variety of evidence-based physical therapy techniques and interventions.
  • Create personalized rehabilitation programs designed to help patients achieve their functional goals and maximize independence.
  • Administer medically prescribed physical therapy treatments to relieve pain, improve or restore function, increase mobility, and promote healing.
  • Ensure all treatment is provided in accordance with the established plan of care.
  • Monitor patient responses to treatment interventions and modify treatment approaches as clinically appropriate in collaboration with the interdisciplinary team (IDT).
  • Provide clinical support, education, and guidance to patients, family members, and caregivers.
  • Collaborate with other members of the interdisciplinary team to promote coordinated, high-quality patient care.
  • Ensure all documentation is completed accurately, thoroughly, and in a timely manner in accordance with company policies and applicable state and federal regulations.
  • Comply with all applicable rules, regulations, policies, procedures, and professional standards.
  • Attend required meetings and participate in other duties as designated by the Director of Rehabilitation.

Physical Therapist Skills & Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a skilled nursing facility (SNF) or long-term care setting preferred.
  • Current knowledge of physical therapy treatment practices, techniques, and interventions.
  • Familiarity with the Net Health electronic documentation system is preferred.
  • Strong clinical, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to effectively work with patients and residents with a variety of personalities, needs, and abilities.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with patients, families, caregivers, and members of the interdisciplinary team.
  • Commitment to providing compassionate, patient-centered care.

Physical Therapist Requirements

  • Active and valid Physical Therapy license inNJ.
  • Must be in good standing with all applicable regulatory agencies and licensing boards.

Physical Therapist Responsibilities

  • Consult patients to understand their individual needs, concerns, and rehabilitation goals.
  • Perform comprehensive patient evaluations and assess and interpret evaluation findings and test results.
  • Develop individualized treatment plans using a variety of evidence-based physical therapy techniques and interventions.
  • Create personalized rehabilitation programs designed to help patients achieve their functional goals and maximize independence.
  • Administer medically prescribed physical therapy treatments to relieve pain, improve or restore function, increase mobility, and promote healing.
  • Ensure all treatment is provided in accordance with the established plan of care.
  • Monitor patient responses to treatment interventions and modify treatment approaches as clinically appropriate in collaboration with the interdisciplinary team (IDT).
  • Provide clinical support, education, and guidance to patients, family members, and caregivers.
  • Collaborate with other members of the interdisciplinary team to promote coordinated, high-quality patient care.
  • Ensure all documentation is completed accurately, thoroughly, and in a timely manner in accordance with company policies and applicable state and federal regulations.
  • Comply with all applicable rules, regulations, policies, procedures, and professional standards.
  • Attend required meetings and participate in other duties as designated by the Director of Rehabilitation.

Physical Therapist Skills & Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a skilled nursing facility (SNF) or long-term care setting preferred.
  • Current knowledge of physical therapy treatment practices, techniques, and interventions.
  • Familiarity with the Net Health electronic documentation system is preferred.
  • Strong clinical, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to effectively work with patients and residents with a variety of personalities, needs, and abilities.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with patients, families, caregivers, and members of the interdisciplinary team.
  • Commitment to providing compassionate, patient-centered care.

  • Active and valid Physical Therapy license inCT.

Full-Time Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) - In-House Rehab Team!

Position: Full-Time (FT)

Setting: In-House Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF)

Say Goodbye to Contract Company Burnout!

Are you a passionate Physical Therapist Assistant who loves working with the geriatric population but is tired of unrealistic productivity metrics and endless corporate red tape?

At Royal Meadow View, we do things differently. We are proud to operate a 100% in-house therapy department. That means you work directly for our facility, collaborating closely with a dedicated interdisciplinary team that prioritizes patient outcomes over corporate quotas. Come build meaningful relationships with your patients and actually enjoy going to work!

What You’ll Be Doing:

As our full-time PTA, you will be on the front lines of restoring mobility, strength, and confidence for our residents.

  • Treat & Empower: Implement targeted, evidence-based treatment plans designed by the evaluating PT to address mobility, balance, gait, and pain management.
  • Innovate: Carry out specialized programs (like fall prevention and joint replacement recovery) to ensure our patients achieve their highest possible level of independence and success.
  • Collaborate: Partner seamlessly with our PTs, alongside COTAs, SLPs, and nursing teams, to deliver cohesive and comprehensive clinical care.
  • Educate: Empower patients and their families with the physical tools and knowledge needed for safe discharges and active community integration.
  • Document: Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation in accordance with state, federal, and facility guidelines.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Education: Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant program.
  • Licensure: Active (or pending) state PTA license required.
  • Experience: Previous experience in a SNF or adult rehab setting is highly preferred, but a collaborative mindset and passion for patient care are what matter most.
  • Skills: Strong clinical execution, empathy, adaptability, and excellent communication skills.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us (The Perks!):

Because we are in-house, we invest directly in YOU.

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with your experience.
  • Realistic Expectations: Ethical, manageable productivity standards.
  • Comprehensive Health Benefits: Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance.
  • Generous PTO: Paid time off and paid holidays to support your work-life balance.
  • Retirement: 401(k) plan.
  • Culture: A supportive, family-like environment where your voice actually matters.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you are ready to practice therapy the way it was meant to be practiced, we want to meet you!

Culver West Health Center has an amazing opportunity for a Full Time Physical Therapy Assistant (PTA) to join their In-House Therapy Team. We are a 91-bed skilled nursing and rehabilitation center in Culver City, California. We have been providing specialized therapy services and skilled nursing care to our community for over 40 years.

At Culver West Health Center, caring is our main concern. Our organization is built on the premise that the most effective way to provide compassionate care is to:

  • Maintain high medical integrity
  • Foster a team spirit among staff
  • Create friendly, beautiful surroundings for our patients and their visitors

Our team of qualified professionals helps patients recover from surgery, injury, or serious illness. We understand the importance of creating a comfortable and nurturing atmosphere, whether patients stay for short-term treatment or long-term care.

To provide the best quality of care, our trained staff will provide customized care programs for each of our residents, ensuring them the most successful outcomes.

We know that the transition to a skilled nursing facility is challenging. At Culver West Health Center, we strive to ease the process by providing an environment where patients and guests feel informed and comfortable.

Each patient will be paired with a coordinator to help ease the transition and provide a familiar smiling face. Our staff is here to answer any of your questions and lend a helping hand.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Administer treatment to residents and patients with temporary or long-term disabilities to relieve pain, restore or improve function, and promote healing
  • Assure all treatment is delivered in accordance with an established plan of care
  • Provide clinical support and instruct patients, families, and caregivers
  • Monitor patient response to treatment intervention
  • Complete required forms and documentation in accordance with company policy and state/federal regulations
  • Consulting with patients to learn about their physical condition.
  • Assessing and interpreting patient evaluations and test results.
  • Developing treatment plans using a variety of treatment techniques.
  • Creating personalized fitness-oriented health care programs for patients.
  • Administering medically prescribed physical therapy treatments to relieve pain and improve mobility.
  • Advising patients on exercise techniques.
  • Advising patients and their families about in-home treatment options.
  • Providing educational information about injury prevention, ergonomics and ways to promote physical health.
  • Consulting and collaborating with other healthcare professionals.
  • Documenting patient care history.
  • Complying with rules, regulations, and procedures.

Career Advantages:

  • In-house opportunity
  • Practice in an environment built on integrity and progressive, ethical care
  • Clinical expertise & training available
  • Electronic documentation system
  • Work collaboratively with a supportive team of therapists and nursing staff
  • Flexible Schedule

Benefits

  • Medical Benefits
  • Dental
  • Vision
  • PTO

The rehab team is strategically designed with growth, opportunity, and career enrichment in mind! We believe our commitment to compassionate care, innovative solutions, patient focused programs and a reward-for-results culture will enrich the lives of patients and employees alike. Don’t wait to start making a difference - the change begins today.

Full-Time Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) - In-House Rehab Team!

Position: Full-Time (FT)

Setting: In-House Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF)

Say Goodbye to Contract Company Burnout!

Are you a passionate Physical Therapist Assistant who loves working with the geriatric population but is tired of unrealistic productivity metrics and endless corporate red tape?

At Royal Wayland, we do things differently. We are proud to operate a 100% in-house therapy department. That means you work directly for our facility, collaborating closely with a dedicated interdisciplinary team that prioritizes patient outcomes over corporate quotas. Come build meaningful relationships with your patients and actually enjoy going to work!

What You’ll Be Doing:

As our full-time PTA, you will be on the front lines of restoring mobility, strength, and confidence for our residents.

  • Treat & Empower: Implement targeted, evidence-based treatment plans designed by the evaluating PT to address mobility, balance, gait, and pain management.
  • Innovate: Carry out specialized programs (like fall prevention and joint replacement recovery) to ensure our patients achieve their highest possible level of independence and success.
  • Collaborate: Partner seamlessly with our PTs, alongside COTAs, SLPs, and nursing teams, to deliver cohesive and comprehensive clinical care.
  • Educate: Empower patients and their families with the physical tools and knowledge needed for safe discharges and active community integration.
  • Document: Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation in accordance with state, federal, and facility guidelines.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Education: Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant program.
  • Licensure: Active (or pending) state PTA license required.
  • Experience: Previous experience in a SNF or adult rehab setting is highly preferred, but a collaborative mindset and passion for patient care are what matter most.
  • Skills: Strong clinical execution, empathy, adaptability, and excellent communication skills.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us (The Perks!):

Because we are in-house, we invest directly in YOU.

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with your experience.
  • Realistic Expectations: Ethical, manageable productivity standards.
  • Comprehensive Health Benefits: Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance.
  • Generous PTO: Paid time off and paid holidays to support your work-life balance.
  • Retirement: 401(k) plan.
  • Culture: A supportive, family-like environment where your voice actually matters.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you are ready to practice therapy the way it was meant to be practiced, we want to meet you!

About Quality Rehab Management, LLC:

At QRM, we strive to make a difference in the lives of patients and in the operational success of the facilities and therapy teams we support. Our team is dedicated to empowering one another to achieve greatness and to creating lasting, meaningful change in the long-term care industry. Since our inception in 2018, we have seen our mission come to life, and we remain humbled and vigilant in our commitment to excellence. We understand collaboration is key when it comes to bolstering employee and client success. Through consistent education and enrichment, we can uncover new strategies which propel our clients towards success and strengthen our approach. By continuously keeping a watchful eye on the ever-changing nature of the long-term care industry, we remain alert and hold ourselves accountable for providing thoughtful support to our fellow team members who in turn provide excellent service to our clients.

  • Complete required forms and documentation in accordance with company policy and state/federal regulations

  • Documenting patient care history.
